_comment: Purple Line anti-bunching: a bus sitting at `stage` leaves about offset_s after the bus ahead of it reaches `trigger` (stop names matched by substring). Hours are local start hours, inclusive. Offsets are the medians measured 2026-08-20..09-30 (weekdays) minus 30 s, an early lean so fewer riders miss a bus that goes before the rule says (replay 2026-10-18, see purple_release.py). Hours not listed fall back to the dwell history.
_gap_comment: Fontaine spacing hold (purple_release.gap_holds): a bus at or heading to Fontaine leaves at the later of arrival + min_dwell_s and gap_s after the bus ahead left; with `capacity` buses there, the first goes -cap_lag_s before the next pulls in (measured median 73-86 s before; user: usually a minute or two). gap_s = the measured 240 s afternoon median minus 30 s (prod logs 11-04..11-11; 180-300 s tried in replay, 210 the only one better on both error and buses-came-early).
